LanguageData.FI_TierUp: {PAWN_labelShort}'s ability "{ABILITY}" reached tier {TIER}. Its cooldown is now shorter.
LanguageData.FI_TierNext: {REMAIN} more kills to the next tier
LanguageData.FI_TierLocked: This ability is locked at tier 1.
LanguageData.FI_Settings_Header: Per-ability tier thresholds (cumulative kills of the same species)
LanguageData.FI_Settings_Invalid: Warning: values must be tier 1 ≤ tier 2 ≤ tier 3. They are corrected automatically when you close this window.
LanguageData.FI_Settings_Note: Min 1, max 999, tier 1 ≤ tier 2 ≤ tier 3. Changes apply immediately to running games (tiers recalculated from kill counts). Abilities from other enabled DLCs appear here automatically.
LanguageData.FI_Settings_TraitCommonalityTip: 0 = never appears naturally, default 0.3, max 5. Weighed against other traits' commonality. Does not affect pawns already generated.
LanguageData.FI_Stat_CurrentTierDesc: Current tier of the selected pawn. The cooldown above also uses this tier.
LanguageData.FI_Stat_TierRowDesc: Cooldown per tier and required cumulative kills of the same species (reflects mod settings).
LanguageData.FI_Settings_RaiderChance: Chance a raider carries the Feral Inheritance gene: {VALUE}
LanguageData.FI_Settings_RaiderChanceTip: Requires Biotech. Each hostile raider has this chance to arrive with the gene and one learnable ability (fixed at tier 1). Default 2%, max 20%, 0 disables.
